description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
